excerpt: How to Calculate Physical Presence for Canadian Citizenship Application Published by: Can X Global Solutions Inc. One of the most important requirements when applying for Canadian citizenship is proving that you have been physically present in Canada for a certain number of days. Miscalculating this can lead to delays, refusals, or returned applications. That’s why understanding how to accurately calculate your physical presence is crucial before submitting your citizenship application.
